To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) most of the evaluation platforms have been designed for the evaluation of a particular routing protocol, (ii) most of the platforms are based on simulation and only a few of them are based on emulation and experimentation, and (iii) only a few evaluation platforms have been developed to address the resilience dimension of the routing protocols they evaluate.

the majority of the evaluation platforms are simulation-based, that the majority of them do not address the resilience dimension, that the majority are focused on the performance dimension, and that the most popular routing protocols are the ones that are more widely evaluated.

the most representative evaluation platform for ad hoc routing is the GloMoSim simulator, the most representative routing protocols are the AODV, OLSR, TORA and DSR protocols and, finally, the experimental methodologies are mainly based on the evaluation of metrics that are related to the routing service.
